I can’t send the refund to your sister’s bank account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, even if someone else is handling your finances (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like me to request the refund to your original credit card instead?

I won’t create a refund proposal since you’ve declined that option.
